translation: dumneavoastră în mesaje; imperativ (pers. a II-a sg.) la butoane și meniuri
note: As macOS, LibreOffice and Firefox do in Romanian: buttons, menu items and tool tips that name a command use the short imperative ("Deschide…", "Salvează o copie…", "Anulează"); sentences that address the user use the polite plural ("Deschideți o lamă pentru…", "Faceți clic…"), never "tu".
No English Title Case: "Export Image…" → "Exportă imaginea…". Product and format names keep their capitals. No capital after a colon.
Always ș/ț with comma below (U+0219, U+021B), never ş/ţ with cedilla; î at the start and end of words and after prefixes ("reîncearcă"), â inside words, "sunt".
Romanian quotes around names and inserted values: „{}”. Inner quotes « ». Keep straight quotes only inside code, commands and configuration examples.
